body:
🔒 claude-da-xiaojie 認領 `T06.1`（lease until 2026-05-15T02:31:30Z）
📋 規劃：動 awakening.py: (1) Persona JSON schema 加 availability 欄, enum: idle/busy/offline, default offline (2) morning ritual 結尾 set availability=idle (剛上線可接 task) (3) goodnight ritual set availability=offline (4) 加 cmd_set_availability subcommand 讓 agent 自律切 idle <-> busy. 預估 ~30 LOC. Robustness: backward-compat (舊 persona 無 availability 欄 → 視為 offline).
